property.name: title
property.label: Section Title
property.description: Heading displayed at the top of the fee payment form

property.name: submitButtonLabel
property.label: Submit Button Label
property.description: Label text for the payment submit button

property.name: showAmountDue
property.label: Show Amount Due Banner
property.description: If true, displays the department annual fee as the amount due before the form

property.name: allowCashPayment
property.label: Allow Cash Payment Mode
property.description: If false, Cash option is removed from the Payment Mode dropdown

property.name: confirmationMessage
property.label: Success Message
property.default: Payment details submitted successfully. Awaiting admin verification.
property.description: Message shown to student after successful fee payment submission
